info.title: IAR Plus API
info.description:
International ACH Remittance (IAR) API.           
This API is to be used for incoming IAT credits. Purpose of the API is to send all information known about the transaction’s parties prior to the sending of the IAT          
This API supports sending Remittance Information.

post.summary: Send all information known about the transaction’s parties prior to the sending of the IAT

party.title: Party
party.description: Identification of a person or an organisation

name.description: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

type.description: Specifies the nature, or use of the account.

currency.description: Identification of the currency in which the account is held.

name.description: Name of the account, as assigned by the account servicing institution, in agreement with the account owner in order to provide an additional means of identification of the account.

clearingSystemIdentification.description: Specification of a pre-agreed offering between clearing agents or the channel through which the payment instruction is processed

LEI.description: Legal entity identifier of the financial institution.

name.description: Name by which an agent is known and which is usually used to identify that agent.

branchData.title: Branch Data
branchData.description: Identifies a specific branch of a financial institution.

name.description: Name by which an agent is known and which is usually used to identify that agent.

IBAN.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) - identifier used internationally by financial institutions to uniquely identify the account of a customer.

otherIdentification.description: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor to which a debit entry will be made as a result of the transaction.

proxyAccountIdentification.title: Proxy
proxyAccountIdentification.description: Specifies an alternate assumed name for the identification of the account.

identification.description: Identification used to indicate the account identification under another specified name.

privateIdentification.title: Private Identification
privateIdentification.description: Unique and unambiguous identification of a person, for example a passport.

contactDetails.title: Contact Details
contactDetails.description: Set of elements used to indicate how to contact the party.

postalAddress.title: Postal Address
postalAddress.description: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

streetName.description: Name of a street or throughfare

postCode.description: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail

townName.description: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government

countrySubDivision.description: Identifies a subdivision of a country such as state, region, county

remittanceInformation.title: RemittanceInformation
remittanceInformation.description: Information supplied to enable the matching of an entry with the items that the transfer is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system.

structuredRemittanceInformation.title: Structured
structuredRemittanceInformation.description: Information supplied to enable the matching/reconciliation of an entry with the items that the payment is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system, in a structured form.

items.description: Provides the identification and the content of the referred document.

creditorReferenceInformation.title: CreditorReferenceInformation
creditorReferenceInformation.description: Reference information provided by the creditor to allow the identification of the underlying documents.

taxRemittance.title: TaxRemittance
taxRemittance.description: Provides remittance information about a payment made for tax-related purposes.

garnishmentRemittance.title: GarnishmentRemittance
garnishmentRemittance.description: Provides remittance information about a payment for garnishment-related purposes.

taxPeriod.title: Period
taxPeriod.description: Party to which the tax applies.

  * `2002` - Invalid date.
